# .github

GitHub automation and README images.

## What's here

- `workflows/deploy-production.yml`: on push to `main`, runs tests, builds, publishes to GitHub Pages
- `workflows/deploy-staging.yml`: same for the `staging` branch
- `workflows/todo-to-issue.yml`: turns `TODO`, `BUG` and similar comments into GitHub issues
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: bug report form
- `readme/`: banner, strips and badges for the READMEs, generated by `npm run build:readme`. Don't edit by hand.
- `copilot-instructions.md`: notes for AI assistants
